catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acoemetae: A 1913 entry on the Acoemetae — the sleepless monks of Constantinople. Joseph Sollier tells of their endless psalmody. Day and night the chant never ceased. Prayer without pause, in relays. Their abbots quarreled with emperors and patriarchs. The Studion inherited their fervor.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acta-sanctoru: This 1913 reference piece on the Acta Sanctorum Hiberniae — Colgan's great lives of the Irish saints. William Grattan-Flood honors the Louvain Franciscan. His folios saved Ireland's holy memory. A monument of Irish scholarship.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acta-triadis-: A 1913 entry on the Acta Triadis Thaumaturgae — Colgan's lives of Patrick, Brigid, and Columba. William Grattan-Flood praises the wonder-working three. Ireland's three great patrons in one volume. Hagiography's Irish crown.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ad-universali: A 1913 entry on the papal constitution Ad Universalis Ecclesiae — its occasion, contents, and force. P.M.J. Rock explains the document. Rome's governing voice, in formal dress. Church law at its most solemn.
